page_title: TOR 2-1 SAS | Torino v Sassuolo 08/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' The referee is firm and issues Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) a deserved yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Alberto Paleari is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
89' Niels Nkounkou (Torino) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
88' Duvan Zapata (Torino) serves up a nice cross, but Arijanet Muric punches the ball away.
86' A substitution has been made. Rafael Obrador is replaced by Niels Nkounkou (Torino).
86' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Giovanni Simeone will be replaced by Sandro Kulenovic (Torino).
86' This is a yellow card! Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
84' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Substitution. Darryl Bakola (Sassuolo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Nemanja Matic walks off.
82' Duvan Zapata (Torino) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
81' Sassuolo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
80' A lofted cross from Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
76' The referee signals a substitution. M'Bala Nzola (Sassuolo) is brought on as a substitute for Andrea Pinamonti.
75' Here is a change. Josh Doig is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Ulisses Garcia (Sassuolo).
72' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Galipo saw the whole situation.
70' 2 - 1 Marcus Pedersen (Torino) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.
70' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' Matteo Prati will be replaced by Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino).
66' 1 - 1 GOAL! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) latches onto a cross and sends the ball into the top right corner with a powerful header!
64' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
64' Matteo Prati (Torino) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
63' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Cristian Volpato is replaced by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo).
63' It is time for a substitution. Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) is on for Luca Lipani.
62' What a chance that is! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
61' Simone Galipo blows for a foul after Enzo Ebosse (Torino) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
60' A nice individual effort by Marcus Pedersen (Torino) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
59' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Duvan Zapata (Torino) replaces Alieu Njie.
59' That will be all from Valentino Lazaro who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marcus Pedersen (Torino).
56' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
56' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

45+1' 1 additional min. will be played.

45' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Arijanet Muric was alert and the score remains the same.
42' Sassuolo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
41' Matteo Prati (Torino) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
40' The linesman points to the corner flag, Torino are going to take it.
39' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!
38' Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.

33' It will be a corner kick for Torino.

31' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
31' The ball is cleared after Alieu Njie (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Simone Galipo blows his whistle as Matteo Prati (Torino) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
25' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

22' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
21' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sassuolo comes to nothing.
20' Matteo Prati (Torino) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' The statistic for corner kicks – 1:1.
15' What a big chance! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
15' Sassuolo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' Alieu Njie (Torino) meets a cross inside the box and heads it goalwards. Unfortunately for him, he sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a chance!
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.
10' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the bottom right corner, but Arijanet Muric shows his agility and makes a save.
9' A pass by Rafael Obrador (Torino) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alberto Paleari, who smothers the ball.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) was too aggressive in his challenge.
6' A pass by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
6' Matteo Prati (Torino) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simone Galipo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
4' A long pass, executed by Luca Marianucci (Torino), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
3' Rafael Obrador (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

3' A neat pass is well received by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
